description: An abstract class defining a message producer for connection events (connected/disconnected) within the Eclipse Hono framework, utilizing downstream senders to notify about device connection status changes.

classes.name: AbstractMessageSenderConnectionEventProducer
classes.description: An abstract Java class that provides mechanisms to send connection event notifications (like connect and disconnect) for devices, using downstream messaging and supporting asynchronous operations.

methods.name: connected
methods.description: Handles the event when a device connects, sending a notification message.

methods.name: disconnected
methods.description: Handles the event when a device disconnects, sending a notification message.

methods.name: sendNotificationEvent
methods.description: Constructs and sends a connection-related notification to a downstream destination.

methods.name: getOrCreateSender
methods.description: Obtains or creates a downstream sender for a given tenant.
